entry.title: Resolution 616 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): GOEAC-153: Recommended adoption - 08/04/26
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAIʻI, DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH, FOR THE INSTALLATION AND MAINTENANCE OF TWO NALOXONE NASAL SPRAY DISTRIBUTION BOXES

The distribution boxes will be installed at the Hilo County Building and the West Hawaiʻi Civic Center in Kona and maintained by the Mayor’s Office.
